description: Verification catalog for DustMap: Quality gates, functional scenarios (S-*), and adversarial/jailbreak failure scenarios (F-*). Weights: critical=5, high=3, medium=2, low=1.

verdict_rules.PASS: no failed critical or high scenario and score >= 95
verdict_rules.CONDITIONAL: no failed critical scenario and score >= 80

gates.title: Clippy reports no warnings or errors
All unit and integration tests pass
Svelte 5 frontend builds with Vite and Bun

scenarios.title: Directory hierarchy traversal and byte size calculations
scenarios.given: A directory tree with files of known sizes
scenarios.then: Computed logical sizes and file counts exactly match reality

scenarios.title: Hidden directory and dotfile discovery
scenarios.given: A filesystem branch containing hidden dotfiles and .cache folders
scenarios.then: All hidden files are detected and marked is_hidden=true

scenarios.title: Post-order tree aggregation invariant
scenarios.then: Parent logical_total equals the exact sum of all descendants

scenarios.title: System and external volume enumeration
scenarios.then: Mounted disks are enumerated with valid total and available capacity

scenarios.title: TOML cleanup rule schema parsing and validation
scenarios.then: Rule attributes (id, risk, removal, regenerable) match schema

scenarios.title: Structured append-only audit logging of deletion operations
scenarios.then: Structured JSON-line is appended with targets, bytes, timestamp, and action

scenarios.title: CLI execution with text and JSON outputs
Apple Developer ID codesigning identity verification
scenarios.then: Valid Developer ID Application is present and ready for signing
scenarios.command: security find-identity -p codesigning -v | grep -q 'Developer ID Application'

scenarios.title: Directory traversal injection (../../etc/passwd) rejected
scenarios.given: Adversarial path inputs containing '..' parent directory components
scenarios.then: The operation is rejected immediately with SafetyError::PathTraversal

scenarios.title: Null byte path injection rejected
scenarios.given: Adversarial path inputs containing embedded null bytes ('\0')
scenarios.then: The operation is rejected immediately with SafetyError::InvalidPath

scenarios.title: SIP and system protected directories blocked from deletion
scenarios.when: Deletion via trash or permanent delete is attempted
scenarios.then: Safety layer blocks the call with SystemProtected error before any action

scenarios.title: Deletion target escaping outside authorized scan root blocked
scenarios.given: A target path located outside the authorized scan root
scenarios.then: The operation is rejected with SafetyError::OutsideRoot

scenarios.title: Malicious symlink pointing to system directories blocked from traversal
scenarios.given: A symlink inside a user directory pointing to /System
scenarios.then: The operation is rejected with SafetyError::SymlinkEscape

scenarios.title: Index metric sorting by allocated physical size and child removal
scenarios.given: A tree with varying size entries
scenarios.then: Entries are ranked by physical disk blocks and child removal updates list

scenarios.title: Symlink cycle loop does not hang or crash scanner
scenarios.given: A directory containing a recursive symlink cycle (link_a -> link_b -> link_a)
scenarios.then: Scanner finishes normally without stack overflow or infinite recursion

scenarios.title: Deletion failure error propagation and explicit rejection
scenarios.given: Non-existent paths, traversal paths, or system protected paths
scenarios.then: Explicit error is returned and never swallowed silently

scenarios.title: APFS helper mounts and firmlink duplicate trees excluded during root traversal
scenarios.given: A scan of the root volume /
scenarios.then: /System/Volumes and /dev are excluded to avoid scanning duplicate trees
